reason: Start the bone construction by adding mineral to its collagen framework; both are highlighted in the same mature bones.
expectation: I expect a mineralized bone framework, though it may still need vessels or living cells.

alternatives.reason: This also directly advances a goal, but I chose to begin with the bones.

effect: Mineral strengthens the collagen framework, but the bones still need a living cell lineage and blood supply.
reaction: The contrast between flexible collagen and compression-resistant mineral is useful.
reason: Develop the bone-cell lineage to progress toward living bones.
expectation: I expect bone-lineage cells to develop from a subset of the stem-cell descendants, though further maturation may be needed.

alternatives.reason: The lined capsule also advances a goal, but I want to continue the bone construction first.

effect: The lineage produces osteoblasts and embedded osteocytes, providing the living cells needed for the bone framework.
reaction: The distinction between matrix-producing osteoblasts and embedded osteocytes is useful.
reason: Add the bone cells to the mineralised framework to assemble living bone.
expectation: I expect the framework to contain living bone cells; it may still need blood vessels.

alternatives.reason: Blood vessels are also needed, but I prefer to combine the cells with the framework first.

effect: The mineralised framework now contains bone cells, and the unfilled vessel outline identifies the remaining blood-supply detail.
reaction: The separate vessel outline makes the next step clear.
reason: Add blood vessels to complete the supplied living bone assembly.
expectation: I expect living arm bones with a blood supply, completing the bone goal.

alternatives.reason: The joint capsule also needs its lining, but I want to finish the bones first.

effect: The bones now have vessels, and the new goal is to connect them into a supported, movable joint.
reaction: The cutaway clearly separates the vessel, cells and mineralised matrix.
reason: Line the fibrous sleeve to advance the capsule goal.
expectation: I expect a joint capsule lined by synovial membrane, with cartilage surfaces remaining separate.

alternatives.reason: Cartilage should also help form the joint, but the capsule is an explicit current goal.

effect: The lined capsule is complete; the remaining goal is to connect the bones into a supported, movable joint.
reaction: The lining's contribution to joint fluid makes its purpose clearer.
reason: Add cartilage to the bone ends as the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect cartilage-covered arm bone ends that can later be assembled with the capsule and ligaments.

effect: The bone ends now have cartilage caps, ready to be joined with the capsule.
reaction: The sliding-surface inset makes the cartilage's role clear.
reason: Combine the capped bones with the capsule; this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect a fluid-lined elbow joint assembly that may still need ligaments for support.

effect: The capped bone ends are now enclosed in a fluid-lined capsule; ligaments remain to support the joint.
reaction: The connection between the lining, fluid and gliding surfaces is clear.
reason: Add the ligaments for support; this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect a supported, movable elbow joint that completes the remaining goal.

effect: The ligaments complete the supported, movable elbow and the final goal.
reaction: The bending and sideways-resistance arrows make the ligaments’ role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the supplied living bones was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway brings mineral, collagen, cells and vessels together while keeping their roles distinct.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final assembly became predictable, with only one combination offered at each step. The capsule and cartilage pictures were clear, but the choices felt repetitive.

surprise.text: The bone-cell lineage clarified that some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes, rather than bone being just mineral and collagen.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though adding bone cells to a mature framework compresses development into an assembly; the cutaway description makes that distinction explicit.

continue.text: I would continue: the constructions connect familiar cell biology to the mechanics of a joint, even if the closing sequence offers limited choice.
